title: 花旗ECM联席主管：中国市场情绪偏弱，但募资能力才是健康标尺
speaker: Unknown (Citi Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Markets)

segments.en: How are investors looking, or even companies that you talk to, looking at the China market now? I mean, yes, it's been a bumper year when it comes to IPO's, but market sentiment in greater China is quite weak now.
segments.zh: 投资者，或者与您交谈的公司，现在如何看待中国市场？是的，IPO方面是丰收年，但大中华区市场情绪目前相当疲弱。

segments.en: There seems to be a disconnect with the amount of fundraising and what people want to really kind of do and anyways companies want to do and how investors are looking at public markets now.
segments.zh: 募资规模与人们真正想做的事、公司想做的事，以及投资者当前如何看待公开市场之间，似乎存在脱节。

segments.en: How do you bridge that gap? I think it's an incredibly interesting question. I think there are two different aspects to it.
segments.zh: 您如何弥合这一差距？我认为这是个非常有趣的问题。我认为有两个不同方面。

segments.en: I think the first aspect is in reality, the real underlying health of a market is determined in my view by can companies raise the capital they need to raise in this market.
segments.zh: 我认为第一个方面是，实际上，在我看来，一个市场真正的底层健康程度取决于公司能否在这个市场募集到它们所需的资本。

segments.en: And whether that be IPO's, whether that actually be large, some follow-ons, there've been some large follow-ons that have happened as well, those have all been met with great receptivity from the markets.
segments.zh: 无论是IPO，还是大型增发，已经有一些大型增发发生，这些都得到了市场的积极接纳。

segments.en: I think the other aspect of one is really a function of where valuations are. If you think about where valuations are in China, in the US, these are not all-time high levels.
segments.zh: 我认为另一个方面实际上取决于估值所处的位置。想想中国和美国的估值，这些并非历史最高水平。

segments.en: And actually, in some sense, it actually gives us the confidence that this is a rally that can run for some more time.
segments.zh: 实际上，从某种意义上说，这反而给了我们信心，认为这轮行情还能持续一段时间。

segments.en: I think apart from that, there are a bunch of macroeconomic aspects which I think are separate for every market and every geography, which also play in the thinking and the vibe and the mood that investors have.
segments.zh: 除此之外，我认为还有一系列宏观因素，这些因素对每个市场和地区各不相同，也会影响投资者的思考、氛围和情绪。

segments.en: I guess just the follow-on-evans question there and I think what's happened in especially in Hong Kong is it seems and it could be wrong.
segments.zh: 我想接着问一个后续问题，尤其是在香港发生的情况，看起来——也可能是错的。
